Interfaces — 8 Oct 2026 · Overcast + Dead Channel
The six owner notes of 8 Oct against the refined canvas and main as synced, redrawn where they bite. Only the touched surfaces are here; everything not drawn keeps its 6 Oct frame, re-set on the ladders below. Real size: Mac windows 1,180pt, iPhone 393pt. Day first, dusk below.
1Scale — two ladders, one per platform. Mac: ask 20 · statement 15 · label and body 13 · mono 12 · summary 12 · keyword 11 · chip 11 · buttons 28 · gaps 18 / 9 / 8 · card padding 22. iPhone: ask 24 · statement 16 · label 15 · body and mono 13.5 · summary 12.5 · keyword 11.5 · buttons 44 · gaps 20 / 10 / 10. Sidebar rows: serif 14 / mono 12 on Mac, 15.5 / 12.5 on iPhone. Nothing under 11.5pt on iPhone; Mac keeps 11 as its mono floor (the native caption size).
2Tasks reconciled with Inbox — one row grammar (R31): keyword line with chips trailing · serif line · mono context with the time trailing · one guidance link. For a task the keyword is its status, in the chip’s cut. The section switcher carries both counts (`Inbox 14 · Tasks 3`): open items, active tasks. ◆ 6.1 — the four-phase sentence and the hold text leave the row; the current phase and round stay in the context line (`freeside · #724 · Verification · Round 1`).
3Notices state, buttons act — R14 revised: a notice never carries a text action. In a card the act stays in the control group (Retry Sending Stop beside Refresh Task Status); on a standing banner it is an outlined button on its own line under the sentence; Revoked empties the pane around a filled Pair Again.
4One fill rule for sheets — Submit fills only when the form is valid, otherwise the disabled recipe — identical day and dusk. Cancel is always the outline.
5Empty states — R13 revised: system glyphs return (archivebox for Inbox, checklist.checked for Tasks, lock.slash for Revoked — named under each). The key mark stays on the menu-bar status item only.
6Alignment — the detail pane is top-leading: card, summary, banners and timelines start at one x, 24pt in, max width 640, and summary and timelines sit in the same bordered card as a decision. Nothing floats.
Rules this canvas changes
R10 — two ladders replace the one 4b scale. R13 — glyph, not key. R14 — no action text in a notice. R31 — task rows take the inbox grammar. R6 — sheet submit fills when valid. R18 — detail pane leading, not centred. The decision card keeps its border (tried without on Card Box Options, 8 Oct — reverted), and the operational summary and timelines now take the same bordered card, so the detail pane always holds one card. Banners and empty states stay on the pane ground.
Each ◆ below is still an owner call; the frame draws my default. Unchanged from 6 Oct: every card’s module order, the quote, the disclosure shape, the claim marker, Title Case labels.
Tokens: day diff cuts and dusk hover follow tokens.css as synced from main (#357040 / #A83D2C, hover = ground-3).

Agent question (unverified)i
Which order should the migration run in?
The implementation stopped at the first migration step because the two orders change which clients break during the transition.
Option 1Agent recommends
Store first, then API
Existing rows migrate before any client can read them, and the API keeps the old shape for one release.
Option 2
API first, then store
Clients move immediately, and the daemon reads both shapes until the store migration lands.
Answer and Retry
Answer Without Retry

Agent QuestionEphemeral · main
↻Updated recently
Agent question (unverified)i
Which order should the migration run in?
The implementation stopped at the first migration step because the two orders change which clients break during the transition.
Option 1Agent recommends
Store first, then API
Existing rows migrate before any client can read them, and the API keeps the old shape for one release.
Option 2
API first, then store
Clients move immediately, and the daemon reads both shapes until the store migration lands.
